qa.user_verbatim_complaint: write_json_snapshot treats every session entry as a Claude session, building a wrong session_file path and using the misleading claude_id label for codex tids. No flavor field; session_file always wrong for codex entries.
qa.overall_assessment: Static verification PASS (pending user patch application). The patch BEFORE text matches the actual file exactly at lines 310-321. The AFTER code correctly implements two-step flavor logic, calls find_codex_rollout once per entry, uses jq -n --arg for injection-safe JSON, adds the flavor field, keeps claude_id field name, and keeps claude entries' existing path logic unchanged. Block F verified by code reading: kill set = restart set by construction (all four operations iterate restart_homes[]). No daemon restart in the patch.

out_of_scope_observations.observation: find_codex_rollout returns first filesystem match; if duplicate rollout files exist for the same tid and the first is stale/corrupt while a later one is valid, session_file may remain empty. Codex Issue 2 from dev-report-20260516-212024.json. Recommend: follow-on cycle to add find_valid_codex_rollout that sorts by mtime and returns first validated candidate.

Flavor is re-inferred during peak-snapshot rewrites rather than preserved. If rollout becomes unavailable between snapshot writes, a codex entry can be misidentified as claude. Codex Issue 1 from dev-report-20260516-212024.json. Recommend: follow-on cycle to carry flavor as 4th field through intermediate row format.
